Name: Cook's Tools - More Kitchen Appliances
Author: Novaphene
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4iv8dTW.png[/img]
This mod was originally in this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27061]mod, [/url]but I made a decision to separate it. [b]Now, mod-authors can include this in their mod if it helps ease their time and effort[/b]. Another reason for separating this mod is for me to add a little flexibility for when I'll start another food /desert mod. I made a little experiment with this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27061]mod [/url]for reference. I am open to suggestions! 

This mod introduces a set of kitchen appliances that allow you to create diverse culinary delights with ease. Whether you're brewing coffee, frying snacks, or processing dairy, these new tools will transform your farmhouse kitchen.

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Air Fryer[/b]: Make crispy, healthy snacks.
[*][b]Coffee Machine[/b]: Brew various types of coffee.
[*][b]Ice Shaver[/b]: Whip up icy treats.
[*][b]Spice Grinder[/b]: Create fresh spices for your meals.
[*][b]Dairy Processor[/b]: Craft butter, cheese, and more from dairy products.
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download requirements (see requirements)
[*]Extract them inside your [i]Mods [/i]folder
[*]Launch the game
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/8EJr99D.png[/img]
Credits and thank you so much to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Hayato2236/about-me?gameId=1303]Hayato2236[/url] for doing a Spanish translation for this mod! I am grateful for your patience and support all throughout the phase this has been in on.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RkMutJI.gif[/img]
﻿If you'd like to know what I am working and I will be working on next, visit me on my [url=https://nova-phene.tumblr.com/]tumblr[/url]﻿, where I'm most active.
